magnificationHint: Icons grow as the pointer passes over them.
autoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the Dock's edge to reveal it, on any display.
intellihideHint: Keep the dock visible on the desktop, but automatically hide it when an app is maximized or overlapping so it doesn't waste space.
autoHideDelayHint: Hover time required at screen edge before revealing the dock.
genieHint: While it is on, windows do not use the Windows animations for maximizing or closing.
genieSpeedHint: How long windows take to fly into the dock and back.
defaultItemsHint: Manage the default system shortcuts on the dock.
showStartHint: Show the Windows Start Menu on the left side of the dock.
showExplorerHint: Keep File Explorer pinned to the dock.
showDownloadsHint: Show the Downloads folder on the right side of the dock.
showRecycleBinHint: Show the Recycle Bin on the right side of the dock.
restoreDefaultItemsHint: Restores Start Menu, File Explorer, Downloads, and Recycle Bin.
webAppsHint: Manage installed web applications (PWAs) and custom taskbar icons.
noCustomIcons: No custom icons set. Right-click any app or PWA on the taskbar and choose Change Icon, or customize below.
genieOffHint: Turn on Animation effects in Windows to play this effect.
topNotchHint: Interactive notch at the top center of the screen with fluid spring animations.
topNotchMusicHint: Hover or click to expand controls for what's playing on your PC.
topNotchLyricsHint: Widened notch showing synchronized lyrics with glowing active line.
topNotchIdleEyesHint: When idle, the clock rests and cute mascot eyes come out.
topNotchChargingHint: Expands to confirm when the charger is connected.
sideNotchHint: Curved notch tab on the screen edge displaying live AI usage gauges and reset timers.
sideNotchAutoHideHint: Retracts into the screen edge until the cursor hovers over it.
sideNotchProvidersHint: Circular progress rings and reset cards for Claude, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode.
menuBarHint: Time, battery, and access to the Windows quick settings and notifications.
menuBarAutoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the top edge to reveal it.
menuBarIntellihideHint: Keep the menu bar visible on the desktop, but automatically hide it when an app is maximized or overlapping so it doesn't waste space.
menuBarMusicHint: Music and video, with controls. With music and AI off, the island disappears.
islandStyleHint: Choose between the centered notch or a compact bubble next to the status indicators.
accessoryBatteryHint: Supported mice and headsets. No device queries while off.
aiUsageHint: Uses your existing sessions; checks every 5 min. Never saves credentials.
menuBarBluetoothHint: Show Bluetooth status and open settings beside Wi-Fi.
menuBarBatteryPercentHint: Display the charge percentage next to the battery icon.
menuBarTaskViewHint: Show Task View to manage open windows and virtual desktops.
saveError: The settings could not be saved.
checkUpdatesHint: Settings asks GitHub whether there is a newer version when it opens.
autoUpdateHint: Installs new versions once a day.
updatesError: Could not check. Check your connection.
showRecentsHint: The last three you opened that are not pinned.
mascotHint: A crab marks AI plan changes, charging and energy saver. Hover over it.
resetHint: Back to the out-of-the-box look and behavior. Your pinned apps stay.
updateBannerBody: It brings improvements and fixes. It installs in seconds and the dock comes back on its own.
updateInstallError: The update could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
shortcutsFolderHint: Open a folder's contents from the Dock.
githubError: Could not open GitHub. Try again.
